facts.business: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited manufactures Poly Iso Butylene (PIB) and operates in the petrochemicals sector.
key_risks: Foreign currency risk due to geopolitical developments and trade dynamics
Interest rate risk (though currently not significant as no interest-bearing borrowings)
Equity price risk from listed equity securities
Commodity price risk and supply risk for key raw materials derived from crude oil (naphtha, Isobutylene, butane)
Supply constraints from force majeure-like conditions and government directions prioritizing domestic LPG
Credit risk from trade receivables and investing activities
Liquidity risk managed through reserves and banking facilities
facts.related_party_note: The Company has entered into transactions with related parties in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act. Details disclosed in Ind AS financial statements as required under Ind AS 24.
